notes: 6-week Hosted API trial completed. Product team trialed chat + search flows (support agent + doc search). Observed: ~2M tokens/month during trial, spikes to ~50 QPS during morning ramp, sustained 20 QPS mid-day. Average response ~120 tokens; token distribution estimate: short <=64 tokens ~60%, medium 65-512 ~30%, long >512 ~10%. Also ~200k embedding calls/month for semantic search. Primary driver to move to Dedicated: predictable throughput, data isolation (customer metadata), lower unit cost at scale and ability to set hard routing/fallback policies. Security asks: full SOC2 pack, SSO/SAML integration, audit log retention 1 year, KMS key option, US data residency. UX quote from Head of Product: "hosted latency was great but bursts created variability; need predictability for SLAs." AE notes: customer is cost-sensitive but willing to commit for predictable p95 targets.

dedicated_capacity_needs: Initial ask: support 100 QPS peak with p95 latency <=200ms for chat gen. Concurrency target 40 streams. Token mix: avg reply 120 tokens, avg prompt 40 tokens. Estimate 6–8M tokens/month at steady state with growth to 12M in 6 months. Embeddings traffic separately ~500k vectors/month. Suggested starting config: 2 dedicated GPU nodes with autoscale to +1 for burst (Redwood to propose instance class—prefer A10/A100 comparable). Want canary and A/B rollout support across two model variants.
traffic_forecast: Month 1 (post-dedicated): 3M tokens, avg QPS 25, peaks 80. Month 3: 6M tokens, avg QPS 50, peaks 100. Month 6: 12M tokens, avg QPS 90, peaks 150 (estimated after product launch). Embedding calls forecast: start 200k/month -> 500k/month by month 6.
poc_results_summary: Hosted POC shows model quality acceptable for support and search. Latency under hosted worked for p50 but p95 spikes during bursts. Batch/caching reduced token cost by ~18% in test harness. Engineering impressed with routing/fallback primitives. Primary open items: dedicated sizing confirmation, final pricing for reserved capacity, and SOC2 artifact delivery. Customer asked for a 30-day dedicated POC with clear acceptance criteria (p95 <=200ms, availability 99.5%).
